zh.title: 航空短訊彙整：Vertical航空獲AS9100品質認證 品質管理標準比肩空中巴士與波音；Quantum Systems稱Bundeswehr操作的無人機恢復飛行
zh.summary: 本期收錄3則獨立消息：Vertical航空獲AS9100品質認證 品質管理標準比肩空中巴士與波音、Quantum Systems稱Bundeswehr操作的無人機恢復飛行、報導稱SpiceJet從杜拜出發的四班航班因未付機場費取消。
body: 本期彙整3則航空短訊，各則為獨立事件。部分內容摘自近期站內報導，原文與來源見文末。

1. Vertical航空獲AS9100品質認證 品質管理標準比肩空中巴士與波音
Vertical航空表示，英國標準協會已授予該公司AS9100認證，涵蓋設計與生產的品質管理系統；該公司認為自己是首家取得這項認證的eVTOL開發商，標準與空中巴士及波音採用的相同。

2. Quantum Systems稱Bundeswehr操作的無人機恢復飛行
Quantum Systems稱德軍無人機停飛後恢復飛行；德軍尚未獨立確認此事

3. 報導稱SpiceJet從杜拜出發的四班航班因未付機場費取消
多家媒體稱SpiceJet從杜拜出發的四班航班因未付機場費取消。

en.title: Aviation briefs: Vertical Aerospace earns AS9100 certification, matching Airbus and Boeing quality standard; Quantum Systems Says Drones Operated by Bundeswehr Are Flying Again
en.summary: 3 independent updates: Vertical Aerospace earns AS9100 certification, matching Airbus and Boeing quality standard; Quantum Systems Says Drones Operated by Bundeswehr Are Flying Again; Reports say four SpiceJet flights from Dubai were cancelled over unpaid airport fees.
body: 3 independent aviation updates. Includes excerpts of recent reports, with original reports and sources linked below.

1. Vertical Aerospace earns AS9100 certification, matching Airbus and Boeing quality standard
Vertical Aerospace says the British Standards Institution has granted it AS9100 certification, making it, in the company's view, the first eVTOL developer to meet the quality standard used by Airbus and Boeing. The UK firm says the certification covers its quality management system across design and production.

2. Quantum Systems Says Drones Operated by Bundeswehr Are Flying Again
Quantum Systems says Bundeswehr drones resumed flying after precautionary grounding; German military has not independently confirmed the resumption.

3. Reports say four SpiceJet flights from Dubai were cancelled over unpaid airport fees
Reports say four SpiceJet flights from Dubai were cancelled over unpaid airport fees.

facts.claim: Quantum Systems announced on November 13, 2026, that its drones operated by the Bundeswehr are flying again.
facts.sourceQuote: On November 13, 2026, Quantum Systems announced that its drones operated by the Bundeswehr are flying again

facts.claim: The German armed forces grounded the drones as a precaution following a cyberattack on the manufacturer.
facts.sourceQuote: its drones operated by the Bundeswehr are flying again, after the German armed forces grounded them as a precaution following a cyberattack on the manufacturer.

facts.claim: Quantum Systems did not specify when the grounding began or ended, or how many drones were affected.
facts.sourceQuote: Quantum Systems did not specify when the grounding began or ended, or how many drones were affected.

facts.claim: The German military has not independently confirmed that flights have resumed.
facts.sourceQuote: The German military has not independently confirmed that flights have resumed.

facts.claim: Quantum Systems said in a statement published on November 12, 2026, that it had identified a cybersecurity incident at the end of October.
facts.sourceQuote: In a statement published on November 12, 2026, Quantum Systems said that it had identified a cybersecurity incident at the end of October.

facts.claim: An investigation remains underway with state authorities and internal and external cybersecurity experts.
facts.sourceQuote: an investigation remains underway with state authorities plus internal and external cybersecurity experts.

facts.claim: AeroTime reported that several SpiceJet flights from Dubai were cancelled due to unpaid airport fees, according to reports shared by assorted Indian news websites.
facts.sourceQuote: Several SpiceJet flights from Dubai have been cancelled due to unpaid airport fees, according to reports shared by assorted Indian news websites.

facts.claim: AeroTime reported that the Hindustan Times claimed four SpiceJet flights from Dubai to Amritsar, Jaipur, Mumbai and Delhi had been cancelled on November 12, 2026.
facts.sourceQuote: the Hindustan Times claimed that four SpiceJet flights from Dubai to Amritsar, Jaipur, Mumbai and Delhi had been cancelled on November 12, 2026

facts.claim: AeroTime reported that Dubai Airports advised SpiceJet that check-in services would be suspended because of non-adherence to payment conditions.
facts.sourceQuote: Dubai Airports also advised SpiceJet that check-in services would be suspended due to non-adherence to payment conditions, the report said.

facts.claim: A SpiceJet spokesperson told the Hindustan Times that the airline was working with relevant authorities to rectify the situation.
facts.sourceQuote: A SpiceJet spokesperson told the Hindustan Times that the airline was working with the relevant authorities to rectify the situation.

facts.claim: The spokesperson said, “We have adequate bank guarantee cover in place and are working to ensure that the issue is sorted out at the earliest.”
facts.sourceQuote: “We have adequate bank guarantee cover in place and are working to ensure that the issue is sorted out at the earliest,” the spokesperson said.
